measurement: macOS /usr/bin/time -l maximum resident set size is ru_maxrss in bytes for the moonrun child; observer and /usr/bin/time are excluded
scope: peak RSS only; existing resource observer supplies parity, elapsed time, first output and temporary-storage observations
input: deterministic varying decimal keys and ASCII records of 80 bytes (diff: 4096 bytes), with a final shorter LF-terminated record when needed; generated in 64 KiB blocks
diff_validation: first byte changed to x; status 1 and exact unified bytes for one replacement plus three context lines, with fixed left/right labels
lifecycle: positive completed profiles only; serial status() without a deadline, supervised by the parent task
